decisions.reason: The mobile-modular processing concept (MMAK) is a visible strategic direction with a publicized customer success story quantifying over 600,000 euros in annual savings, so the firm is strongly committed to it and has no reason to write it off.
This slow-speed shredder is core to the firm's established offer, has had its own dedicated page for two years, and represents substantial engineering investment, so dropping it is unlikely.
The MMAK concept is publicly backed by a named customer reference (Wiese Umwelt Service) and quantified savings, which makes it central to the announced modular strategy and costly to abandon.
